card.name: Next step verb after dose calculation
card.fires_on: The first word of the next instruction (Remove, Discard, Gently) right after a dose or volume calculation in preparation steps. It also fires on column headings in dosing tables.

modes.label: Remove/Discard after calculation
modes.description: Verb starting the next step after a volume or vial count is worked out, such as Remove or Disc-ard.
modes.example: Round the number of vials up to the next whole number.<< Remove>> the required number of NEXVIA

modes.label: Dosing table headings
modes.description: A heading word in a dosing table row, such as Morning or Location.
modes.example: Rounded to Nearest 25 mg<< Morning>> Dosing Number of Capsule(s)
